description: This file defines the CreateObject class, which implements the <create-object> element for a mini-language used in the OFBiz framework. It dynamically creates an object instance of a specified class using reflection, with parameters specified in the element, and stores the created object in the environment map.

classes.name: CreateObject
classes.description: Implements the <create-object> element, responsible for creating a new object instance dynamically based on class name and parameters, and assigning it into the environment map.

methods.name: CreateObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CreateObject instance based on XML element and the parent SimpleMethod.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the create-object operation by instantiating the target class with specified parameters and storing the created object in the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the create-object element.

inner_classes.name: CreateObjectFactory
inner_classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of CreateObject from XML elements.

methods.name: CreateObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the create-object operation based on the XML element and the simple method context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the creation of the object instance and binds it to the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the create-object element.
